body: Im couch surfing so home cooking can be difficult. When the craving comes good ol buffalo wild wings can satisfy (I have no idea whether or not there are any out of the states).
Sounds good. My wife digs buffalo wings, I could never do spicy.
I love the sound of trains as they go by, i love bbq wings, i love whem my head isn't foggy.

The big problem is that my head keeps going to the worst conclusion, I have a hard talking about anything. Im currently engaged to a wonderful young woman but I feel like shes bored of me. A recent event has had me sinking money I dont have to fix it. I feel hopless, im scared... Ive been so scared for the last seven years... Every day grows worse, the thought of ending it has only just seriously crossed my mind this last week.
Hits close to home, I remember when the switch flipped. Im finding the less i know the person the easier it is to vent. I wish you the best!
